notes.title: Deckception v1.1.3
notes.notes:
- Fixed the sprite of the Rage Dice.
- Fixed Flush Five example for the cards not being correct.

notes.title: Deckception v1.1.2
notes.notes:
- Changed when removing cards and leveling up dice buttons unlock to make the progression feel faster.
- Changed Base, Attack, Magic, Healing, Block, Metal, Berserk, and Titanium dice sprites to make them more detailed.
- Fixed bug where starting stats less than 1 aren't shown.
- Made the tutorial visible in the game play area with a button that is accessible in the pause menu.
- Changed the info screen on the cards side to make it more clear about what hand types are available and what multipliers they have.
- Adjusted the size of the dice info screen.
- Changed class bonuses to make them more effective.
- Adjusted prices of manual dice upgrades.
- Changed how your total money, manual level up price, and ascension price is formatted in the shop, it is now formatted like most other large numbers, using abbreviations.

notes.title: Deckception v1.1.1
notes.notes: - Adjusted the floor number where certain dice unlock to make the game more balanced in the early and late game.

notes.title: Deckception v1.1.0
notes.notes:
[u][b]Major Additions:[/b][/u]

     - Added the Leaderboard and Ranking system.
     - Added 5 more card levels.
     - Added 10 extra upgrades for some Tier 4 and all Tier 5 dice.

[u][b]Major Changes:[/b][/u]

     - Changed some dice multipliers for Tier 4 and 5 Dice to account for new levels.
     - Adjusted prices for higher level cards to make them more balanced.
     - Changed current Dice Info/Manual Level Up Screen to make it more readable.
     - Added hit sound effects for the player and enemy.

[u][b]Minor Changes/Bug FIxes:[/b][/u]

     - Changed capitalization of large abbreviated numbers to make them more readable.
     - Removed decimal places on smaller numbers to make them less confusing.
     - Changed location of card value totals for attack, magic, block and healing.
     - Changed health bar sprites.
     - Slight change to HUD design.

notes.title: Deckception v1.03
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug with the notifications of class unlocks
- Fixed a bug with classes not unlocking when they should (you have to reset your in progress run for changes to take effect, sorry!)

notes.title: Deckception v1.02
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug involving the remove card feature.
- Fixed a bug with the final dice multiplier.
- Fixed a bug involving the saving of starting stats.

notes.title: Deckception v1.01
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug involving the class system. Classes should now unlock when you reach the correct milestone for each class
- To unlock a higher level class reach to next milestone with the previous class unlocked
- Bug is fixed in the demo and full game
